test_name: SET LOCAL ROLE campx_app_server Execution Check
statement: BEGIN; SET LOCAL ROLE campx_app_server; SELECT current_user; ROLLBACK;

error.message: ERROR: permission denied to set role "campx_app_server"

root_cause: In PostgreSQL 16+, executing SET ROLE <role> requires that the current user has the SET option granted on that role. Catalog inspection of pg_auth_members reveals that role 'postgres' has 'campx_app_server' granted with admin_option=true, inherit_option=false, set_option=false. Therefore session_user 'postgres' is disallowed from executing SET ROLE campx_app_server. In contrast, 'authenticated' has set_option=true.
